judgment_text:
ORDER

Seeking to direct the respondents 4 and 5 to consider the petitioner's representation dated 04.03.2026 and reminder dated 07.05.2026 and further direct them to repair the damaged underground pipelines running through the properties comprised in S. Nos. 55/2A1, 55/2A2, 55/1A and 55/2A3 situated at Thungavi Village, Madathukulam Taluk, Tiruppur District and restore the water supply for irrigation of the land comprised in S. No. 55/2A3 of Thungavi Village, Madathukulam Taluk, Tiruppur District, the present Writ Petition has been filed.

2. Notice to the private respondents is dispensed with since no adverse orders has been passed as against the private respondents.

3. Considering the limited scope of the relief sought for, the respondents 4 and 5 are directed to consider the representations of the petitioner dated 04.03.2026 and 07.05.2026, after hearing the petitioner as well as the private respondents and pass appropriate orders and take necessary steps to restore the damaged irrigation pipeline and water supply for irrigation of the petitioner's land comprised in S. No. 55/2A3 of Thungavi Village, Madathukulam Taluk, Tiruppur District, within a period of eight weeks from the date of receipt of a copy of this order.

4. With the above direction, this Writ Petition is disposed of. No costs.
